name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with his father's old Morris Minor in their garage in the Highlands. This early experience ignited a passion for mechanics and engineering, leading him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, Alistair honed his skills working in local garages and fabrication shops, eventually landing a role with a small racing team. He quickly proved his worth, demonstrating a keen eye for detail and an uncanny ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues.

He's now joined the Junior Kart Team, seeking a fresh challenge and the opportunity to mentor young talent. Alistair's approach to fabrication is meticulous; he believes in doing things right the first time, ensuring reliability and performance are never compromised. His ability to see the big picture, combined with his perfectionist tendencies, makes him a valuable asset to any team. He isn't afraid to experiment and refine his techniques to ensure the best possible output.

physical.description: Alistair is a stocky man with a weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils with a pocket knife before starting a new task.
Has a specific playlist of Scottish folk music he listens to while working.
Carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and notes.
